name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.tendsto_transportedFlag_orbit_zero
title: Transported flags vanish on vectors generated by a trace vector

content.assumptions:
Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra with matrix stages $M_{2^n}(\mathbb C)$ embedded by $a\mapsto a\otimes I_2$. Write $f_n$ for the image of the first diagonal matrix unit, $p_n=f_n-f_{n+1}$, and $\omega$ for the root state characterized by $\omega(\iota_n(a))=a_{00}$ on each stage, where $\iota_n$ is its canonical embedding.

Index chosen pure-state Gelfand-Naimark-Segal (GNS) representations by their unitary-equivalence classes $j\in I$, with root index $o$ and representative states $\varphi_j$.

A fixed shell family consists of complex-linear unital star automorphisms $\alpha_j$ and elements $w_{j,n}\in A$ satisfying $\varphi_j(\alpha_j(a))=\omega(a)$, $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=\alpha_j(p_n)$ and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=p_n$.

At the root, $\alpha_o$ is the identity and $w_{o,n}=p_n$. Set $f_{j,n}=\alpha_j(f_n)$.

The space $K$ lies in an arbitrary universe; it need not be separable. The vector-functional equality is assumed for every $a\in A$. Cyclicity of $\xi$ in all of $K$ is not assumed, nor is irreducibility of $\sigma$. Inner products are linear in their second argument. Here $B(K)$ is the algebra of bounded complex-linear operators on $K$.
content.conclusion: Each fixed vector $\sigma(b)\xi$ is sent to zero in the limit. The estimate $\|\sigma(f_{j,n})\sigma(b)\xi\|^2\leq\|b\|^2 2^{-n}$ proves this directly.
content.display_title: Transported flags vanish on vectors generated by a trace vector
content.lean_realization_notes: This declaration is a statement about orbit vectors and norm convergence of their images. It does not claim operator-norm convergence of the projections, or convergence on every vector of an arbitrary ambient representation without an additional argument.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $\sigma:A\to B(K)$ be a unital star representation of the completed CAR algebra on a complete complex Hilbert space. Suppose $\xi\in K$ implements the normalized trace from [the CAR trace construction](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/Trace.lean#L62-L64): $\langle\xi,\sigma(a)\xi\rangle=\tau(a)$ for all $a\in A$. For the transported projections $f_{j,n}$ of a fixed shell family and every $b\in A$, one has $\sigma(f_{j,n})\sigma(b)\xi\to0$ in norm as $n\to\infty$.
content.one_sentence_role: Turns decay of projection traces into norm convergence on each source-orbit vector.

proof_steps.text: Use $p^*=p=p^2$ and star preservation to express the squared norm as $\tau(b^*pb)$.
Use the trace identity and the positive order bound on $pbb^*p$ to obtain $\|\sigma(p)\sigma(b)\xi\|^2\leq\|b\|^2\tau(p)$.
Insert the exact value $\tau(f_{j,n})=2^{-n}$. The nonnegative squared norms are squeezed to zero, which implies norm convergence of the vectors.

content.proof_summary: For a projection $p$, the vector-functional hypothesis gives $\|\sigma(p)\sigma(b)\xi\|^2=\tau(b^*pb)$. Traciality rewrites this as $\tau(pbb^*p)$. Since $0\leq pbb^*p\leq\|b\|^2p$, positivity gives the bound $\|b\|^2\tau(p)$. Apply it to $p=f_{j,n}$, whose trace is $2^{-n}$ by [the transported-flag trace theorem](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/TraceFlag.lean#L42-L46), and let $n$ tend to infinity.
